svg.title: The report's two sources
svg.desc: This school's applications are filtered by academic year and submitted date. From them come the four boxes, by type and status, by month, and waiting more than 3 days. Staff on leave today and staff leave days come from the staff approved-leave record. Students on leave today come from approved student-leave applications.
